headline: Less time on records. More time for students.
linkedin:
I built AttendEase to make a routine classroom task easier: keeping attendance accurate without slowing down the day.

It runs in a browser and keeps records by date, with search, status filters and live counts. I added Excel export, CSV backup and print so the data is useful beyond the screen.

This project pushed me to think about the full workflow, not just the form: entering records, finding them again and taking them out when needed. The code is public here: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/attendance-system

#WebDevelopment #JavaScript #StudentTools
